interface.input: in_valid/in_ready; four INT32 values, four identical-or-distinct cached FP32 combined scales, four valid bits and output address/tag
interface.output: out_valid/out_ready; four BF16 values with same mask/address/tag; error flag for invalid numerical result, held on stalls
interface.clock_reset: same clk/resetn as parent; reset only under coordinated reset
interface.latency: elastic, implementation-reported and hash-pinned; nominal convert2 + multiply6 + BF16 rounding1 =9 cycles; II1 per four-lane bundle

architecture.scale_builder: separate shared FP32 multiply pipeline; precompute combined scales per row-group/head/N16 panel before issuing tagged dots; never recompute with a different rounding sequence
architecture.packing: four BF16 lanes per bundle, low lane at bits15:0; combine two bundles into128-bit stores when adjacent; use byte strobes for short tails and row-boundary splits

numeric.rounding: nearest-even at each listed boundary; no FMA, scale reassociation, approximate reciprocal or intermediate BF16 scales
numeric.subnormal: gradual underflow for FP32 and BF16; preserve signed zero; do not silently substitute flush-to-zero floating-point IP
numeric.errors: positive finite input scales required; nonfinite combined scale, FP32 result or stored BF16 result reports numerical error after quiescence; source numeric contract is authoritative; integer accumulator overflow has no detector/error

verification.comparison: bitwise equality to exact_numeric.py and golden outputs; zero tolerance
cases: last write acceptance before parent response
